test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

______ of money prevented me from purchasing the house.
solution: The correct answer is **Lack.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • "Lack" refers to the absence of something. • Therefore, the complete sentence with the proper word will be, “Lack of money prevented me from purchasing the house.”
